subtitle: the roughest initial data the equation can handle
summary: The KdV equation, a classic model of water waves, still makes reliable predictions when the starting wave is extremely rough.
problem: The Korteweg–de Vries (KdV) equation is a classic model of water waves. This is a proof that it still makes reliable predictions even when the starting wave is extremely rough.
It settles a problem that had stood for decades and reaches the roughest level of initial data the equation can possibly handle: the Sobolev space H⁻¹.
title: KdV is well-posed in H⁻¹
